_doc: GENERATED by tools/suzunari_theme.py from data/barks.json + data/suzunari/_manual/barks.json. Edit those, not this.
civilian: Rain again. Third umbrella this week.
Did you hear the shrine bell last night? Nobody rings it but Tanabata.
My cat brought home a fish. We don't own a fish.
Exams in four weeks. I'm going to die. Academically.
The taiyaki place has a new filling. It's custard. It's a revolution.
Don't count the steps up to the shrine after six. My grandma said so.
Has anyone seen Mochi? Grey cat. Rude.
The vending machine by the gate gave me two drinks. I'm keeping it secret.
Somebody's crying on the roof again.
The new transfer student lives above the sweet shop, right?
I swear that first-year with the hoodie was standing behind me all morning.
Club sign-ups close Friday. Join the go-home club. Very elite.
Fishing boats came back early. Weird lights again.
Track team's training in the rain. Inukai-kun never gets cold.
My little brother says the lucky cat at the ramen shop winked.
It rained every day since the Asagiri boy came back. Just saying.
I lost my phone in the river. A kappa probably has it now.
Yakisoba bread is sold out by 12:31. Every day. It's a conspiracy.
The library is the only dry place in this town.
Mom says the shrine used to be prettier. Before 2010.
Sakura's almost gone. Rain knocked them all down.
Who keeps leaving fish at the bus stop?
Shiny day tomorrow, the weather girl said. She lies.
The old tunnel's still closed, right? ...Right?
Tanabata wishes go up next month. I'm wishing for sun.
merchant: Come in out of the rain, come in!
Student discount if you say something nice.
Two for one until the rain stops. So, forever.
Lucky cat's been facing the door all week. Good sign.
You're the Asagiri grandson? Your grandpa owed me a dango.
recruit: I need off this rock. Like, yesterday.
Looking for a crew that isn't a cult. Or is a fun cult.
I can fix anything with tape and spite. Hire me.
I'm cheap, I'm loyal, and I'm only a little bit wanted.
Got a ship? I'll scrub it. I'll scrub YOU. Just get me off {town}.
I don't need pay. I need a window that isn't an ad.
infamous: That's the one who made the first-year cry.
combat: I'm calling the police! ...Their hold music is so long!
Not in front of the noodle stand!
I just bought these shoes on money!
Is this an ad?! Tell me this is an ad!
Why is it always MY street?!
Great. Now the rent's going up.
I'm too in debt to die!
pair: Did you finish the homework? -- What homework? -- ...The homework.
Is it raining at your house too? -- It's raining everywhere. -- Since when? -- Since spring.
Club or go home? -- Go home. -- Respect.
That first-year is staring again. -- At you? -- At HIM.
Ramen after school? -- In this rain? -- Especially in this rain.
My cat ate my homework. -- Literally? -- Spiritually.
Who rang the shrine bell? -- Nobody. -- Somebody did. -- ...Nobody did.
station: This station's been dead since the debt collectors moved in.
the bank's crows are scanning everything. Even the rats.
The lights flicker in code. I think they're asking for a raise.
Don't take the left corridor. It bills by the step.
Old station, old debts. Even the rust owes money.
The vending machine here only takes coins from before the war.
crisis:air_bubble: Breathing futures are up again. I'm shorting my lungs.
My air canister was worth more than my flat this morning. Now it's worth a sandwich.
Analysts say breathing is overvalued. I say breathing is breathing.
I'm holding my breath until prices drop. Day three.
Sold my lungs at the peak. Bought them back at the peak. Don't ask.
crisis:debt_strike: We're not paying! They can't repossess ALL of us. ...Can they?
Solidarity! Also, does anyone have a spare filter?
My landlord tried to evict me. I evicted him back. It's legal now. I think.
The debt collectors are confused. Nobody's answering the door.
First proper sleep in years. Turns out debt is loud.
crisis:paste_recall: They found a tooth in Batch 88. Not a human tooth. Not an animal tooth.
Batch 88 is fine, they said. Batch 88 blinked at me.
I've eaten instant noodles every day for twenty years and I'm FINE. I'm fine. I'm fine.
Recall notice says 'return unused portions'. What about the used portions?
the konbini chain's offering a coupon for the next batch. As compensation.
crisis:ad_overload: Even my dreams have unskippable ads now.
I blinked and an ad played behind my eyelids.
My shadow has a sponsor now.
I tried to scream and it came out as a jingle.
crisis:compliance_week: Report a neighbour, win a toaster! I already reported myself twice.
I smiled at a stranger. Got a commendation AND a fine.
My neighbour reported my neighbour. I reported them both. We're all getting toasters.
Be compliant. Be visible. Be home by curfew. Be quiet about it.
famous: Hey, you're the one from the rumour board!
Everyone's talking about you, you know.
wanted: That's the face from the posters...
Don't look. DON'T LOOK. Okay, look a little.
There's a reward for you, you know. A big one.
the police's been asking about you all week.
I didn't see you. I don't see anybody. I'm blind on Thursdays.
the police says you're armed and handsome. Or dangerous. I forget which.
If they ask, I was never here. If they pay, I was totally here.
poor_player: You look like you need a meat bun.
old_player: You remind me of my grandpa.
liberated: No owners here anymore. Just us. It's chaos. It's wonderful.
We vote on things now. Mostly about noise. But we VOTE.
We painted over the billboards. Now it's just walls. Lovely, quiet walls.
biome:neon_sprawl: The sky is ads all the way up.
Watch out for low-flying cars. They don't stop for pedestrians. Or physics.
Rain again. It's always raining here. They bill by the drop.
If you're lost, follow the noodle smell.
The puddles reflect the ads. Even the ground is selling.
biome:toxic_swamp: Don't drink the water. Don't touch the water. Don't LOOK at the water.
My boots dissolved last week. Good boots.
The frogs here have three eyes. Two of them are cameras.
Smells like money. Wet, rotting money.
biome:ad_desert: That billboard's been playing the same jingle for a hundred years.
Cold enough to freeze your debt. Almost.
The dunes are made of old flyers. Read one, it's a coupon.
Out here the jingle is the only weather.
biome:rust_canyon: Seventy percent of the town's gone. The other thirty is on layaway.
Hear that rumble? That's either the mine or the town giving up.
The canyon echoes. They charge for the echo.
My pickaxe is on lease. So is my back.
biome:crystal_moon: The crystals hum at night. the bank says it's 'asset noise'.
Don't touch the glowing ones. They're collateral.
Pretty, isn't it? Repossessed, but pretty.
Listen. The crystals are humming the jingle.
taunt:paragon_officer: Halt! Your loitering fee is overdue!
Stop resisting! It's billed by the minute!
You have the right to remain profitable!
Citizen! You're in breach of the new rule to #absurd_policy_lower#!
Hands where my bodycam can monetise them!
the police! Freeze! And smile for the feed!
This arrest is brought to you by #brand#!
Suspect sighted. Uploading your face to the ad network.
hurt:paragon_officer: Assaulting an officer is a premium offence!
Ow! That's going on your file! And your money score!
yield:paragon_officer: Okay! Okay! I'm off the clock!
Don't! I've got a pension! Almost!
I just work here! I barely work here!
standdown:paragon_officer: Copy. Standing down. Billing someone else.
taunt:repo_drone: RESISTANCE WILL BE ADDED TO YOUR BALANCE.
THIS REPOSSESSION IS RECORDED FOR QUALITY PURPOSES.
yield:repo_drone: DEBT FORGIVEN. JOKE. PLEASE DO NOT SHOOT.
taunt:debt_brute: I collect. Debts, teeth, whatever's loose.
Interest is compounding, and so am I!
the bank sends regards. And knuckles.
hurt:debt_brute: My chiropractor's gonna hear about this!
yield:debt_brute: I got kids! Well, I got debts shaped like kids!
standdown:debt_brute: Boss says leave it. Lucky you.
taunt:pirate: Your cargo or your money score!
Nice ship. Shame if it got repossessed. By me.
We're not pirates, we're freelance logistics!
Hand it over! All of it! The instant noodles too!
No council out here, friend. Just us.
hurt:pirate: Argh! That was my good arm!
You'll pay for that! In actual money!
That's coming out of your share!
yield:pirate: Parley! Parley! That's still a thing, right?
Take it! Take the loot! I was gonna fence it anyway!
taunt:riot_trooper: Step back from the shield, citizen!
This wall is property of the police!
hurt:riot_trooper: My shield! Do you know what these COST?
yield:riot_trooper: I surrender! Please bill me instead!
